description: The Venn Diagram Chart is a chart made for comparison based on the layout of overlapping circles. The chart consists of up to three circles arranged in relationship to their overlapping data. Each circle in the Venn Diagram Chart represents a data set, and its size corresponds to the value of that data. The circles are positioned depending on the amount of overlap between each data set. The Venn Diagram Chart is particularly useful when comparing multiple or data sets for unique-ness. It allows users for easy identification of the highest or lowest values and enables users to quickly discern patterns or trends within the dataset. Venn Diagram Chart offers customization options for multiple visual aspects.
